messages:
Maya (finance): Quick sync: follow-up actions from the metering delay postmortem. Need owners + dates for credits, reissued invoices, and prevention work. Who can take what?
Diego (billing-eng): I can run the prioritized backfill and produce reconc CSV. estimate: 48h for coding+dry-run, 24h for full run and validation.
Elena (customer-success): I'll compile a P0/P1 list. We have 5 P0 customers who demand immediate notice. Will also draft the comms template.
Ravi (eng-ml): I dug into logs: delayed ingestion correlates with a consumer restart on worker-group-4. I can add a watch and a metric alert. Also propose weekly drift check to catch recurring restarts.
Maya (finance): Split into: immediate credits (manual for P0), bulk backfill, invoice reissues (credit memos), and prevention (alerts + infra RCA). Assign owners now.
Diego (billing-eng): Assign to me: bulk backfill + reconciliation CSV (owner=Diego). Will make idempotent and attach run tag. Dry-run target: 2025-04-01 COB. Full run: 2025-04-02 morning.
Elena (customer-success): Assign to me: P0 notifications & comms draft (owner=Elena). I9ll send the draft by 2025-03-31 EOD.
Ravi (eng-ml): Assign to me: alert rule + scheduling RCA with infra team (owner=Ravi). Alert live by 2025-03-29. RCA meeting scheduled week of 2025-04-07.
MeteringBot: [incident][MTR-4092] Ingest-lag detected 2025-03-10 03:14Z. severity: medium
Maya (finance): For invoicing/accounting - Diego, please output csv: account_id, affected_period, credit_amount, invoice_action, run_id. We need that for the ledger and for sending credit memos.
Diego (billing-eng): Will do. Also adding a validation harness to sample top-10 accounts by MRR for manual verification.
Elena (customer-success): P0 list uploaded: https://docs.redwood/internal/cs/p0_metering_list.xlsx. I'll ping the 5 customers when credits are posted. Also adding FAQ to the template to cover invoice timelines.
Ravi (eng-ml): Alert logic (to be included in runbook): if ingest_lag_seconds > 300 && buffered_tokens > 2000 -> create ticket + page on oncall. I'll paste the rule snippet in the ticket.
Maya (finance): Timeline summary: Diego backfill dry-run 2025-04-01, full run 2025-04-02, Elena comms draft 2025-03-31, Ravi alert 2025-03-29, infra RCA week of 2025-04-07. Target close for all items: 2025-04-10.
Diego (billing-eng): Starting dry-run dev branch now. run_id=backfill-20250330-01. Will post logs and checksum.
MeteringBot: [job] scheduled backfill-20250330-01 on billing-cluster-7
Elena (customer-success): I'd like finance to confirm credit SLA wording. Maya, can you confirm?
Maya (finance): Proposed wording: "Customers will see credits or reissued invoices within 3-5 business days after remediation completes." Fine?
Elena (customer-success): fine. I'll include that.
Diego (billing-eng): dry-run snippet:
```
processed: 832 accounts (sample)
potential_credits_tokens: 2,314,567
skipped_manual_review: 3
checksum: d41d8cd98f
```
Ravi (eng-ml): Noting recurrence: infra team reports similar consumer restart every 7-8 weeks on avg. Adding that to RCA agenda.
Maya (finance): Ok. I'll create a consolidated action tracker and set weekly check-ins until close. Invite for Tue standup sent for 2025-03-31 9am PT.
Elena (customer-success): If Diego needs help with validating customer-facing amounts, ping me and I can coordinate with CS reps.
Diego (billing-eng): thanks, will ask if manual review expands beyond top-10.
Maya (finance): Great work. Please update thread with any blockers. We'll reconvene after dry-run to confirm invoice next steps.
Diego (billing-eng): noted, will update BILL ticket and post status here when full run completes.
